title: Convex Polygon
description:
You are given an array of points on the X-Y plane points where points[i] = [x i , y i ] . The points form a polygon when joined sequentially. 
 
 Return true if this polygon is convex and false otherwise. 
 
 You may assume the polygon formed by given points is always a simple polygon . In other words, we ensure that exactly two edges intersect at each vertex and that edges otherwise don't intersect each other. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/04/09/covpoly1-plane.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 points = [[0,0],[0,5],[5,5],[5,0]]

Output:
 true
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/04/09/covpoly2-plane.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 points = [[0,0],[0,10],[10,10],[10,0],[5,5]]

Output:
 false
```

 Constraints: 

 3 <= points.length <= 10 4 
 
 points[i].length == 2 
 
 -10 4 <= x i , y i <= 10 4 
 
 All the given points are unique .
